messages:
Mira Patel: quick heads-up — ran the weekly link-catalog scan and got 7 failures. 5 are 404s under /kb and 2 are staging-only shortlinks. can someone claim the /kb ones? i can do one but would prefer to pair up.

docs-bot: weekly-link-scan: 7 issues found — full report: https://redwood-internal/reports/links/1794448888 (auto)

Ben Cho: I can take the KB files. which paths are we talking about? paste the ripgrep you used?

Mira Patel: thanks @Ben. i used: `rg "https?://(.*)shortlink|/kb/" -n docs/ | sed -n '1,200p'` — extracted the 5 kb paths: `docs/kb/runtime/batch-costs.md`, `docs/kb/onboarding/quickstart.md`, `docs/kb/anchors/cache-best-practices.md`, `docs/kb/ops-deps/deploy.md`, `docs/kb/notes/pinning.md`.

Kyle Nguyen: are these hitting prod or only staging? want to know if we should redirect or just update anchors.

Mira Patel: two are staging-only shortlink issues (quickstart.md, notes/pinning.md). the other three are canonical 404s — likely moved in a refactor.

Sara Lopez: quick note — please check `ja/` localized copies before removing anything; some translations still point at the old slugs.

Ben Cho: grabbing them now. plan: single PR with small commits that: replace dead anchors with canonical ones when available, add shortlink redirects for staging-only, and rehost one image referenced by deploy.md.

Ben Cho: opening PR in a bit — will include the ripgrep output in the PR description and a short checklist.

Ben Cho: PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12891 — contains 5 tiny edits + a rehost for /docs/assets/deploy-diagram.png. CI ran locally for me.

Mira Patel: thanks! pinging reviewers @Kyle and @Sara for a quick CR. none of these changes should affect runtime examples, but double-check please.

Kyle Nguyen: i can do a quick pass in the next hour. any flaky doc CI to watch for?

Ben Cho: CI looks clean locally: `npm run docs:lint && npm run docs:build`. no flaky tests expected; one image was large so i optimized it with `svgo`.

Sara Lopez: i'll follow up on `ja/` after merge and open backports if needed. please add a line in the PR description that says "check ja/ mirrors" so i can track it.

Mira Patel: small ask: when merged, add an entry to `docs/CHANGELOG.md` — one line: `link fixes: batch-costs, cache-best-practices, deploy` so SRE/ops can track the change during the next sweep.

Ben Cho: noted. i'll add the changelog line and the localization note. merging after Kyle's review.

Kyle Nguyen: LGTM. :thumbsup: quick pass, left one nit about a heading level.

Ben Cho: addressed the nit, ran CI again, merging now.

Mira Patel: awesome — merged at 1794449100. i'll re-run the scan tomorrow and follow up if anything else pops up. thanks everyone!
